title: How to Choose a Microfibre Car Drying Towel
h1: How to Choose a Microfibre Car Drying Towel
introduction_deck: Choosing a car drying towel is less about chasing one headline specification and more about matching absorbency, handling and finish to the way you wash your vehicle.

data.heading: What matters when choosing a car drying towel

cards.title: Absorbency and coverage
cards.explanation: Look for a towel that can take on water efficiently while covering a useful area of the vehicle. That helps reduce the number of passes without asking you to drag a saturated cloth across the paint.

cards.title: Handling and size
cards.explanation: A towel needs to be large enough to make progress but manageable around mirrors, edges and smaller panels. The right balance depends on the vehicle and how you prefer to work.

cards.title: Construction and finish
cards.explanation: Pile, edge treatment and overall construction affect how confidently the towel can be used on delicate painted surfaces. Treat these as part of the decision rather than relying on GSM alone.

data.heading: Compare the main towel options
limitations: Search evidence describes the decision landscape; it does not replace checking a towel's own validated product information.

data.heading: A practical next step
data.recommendation_context: Once you know which balance of coverage, handling and construction suits your wash routine, you can assess a towel against those criteria rather than buying on a single number.
data.relevance_reason: The validated Heavy Duty Drying Towel is a relevant example for a reader looking for a dedicated car-drying product; it is presented after the decision guidance, not as a substitute for it.
data.cta_direction: Invite the reader to review the product details against the criteria above.

conclusion: The best microfibre car drying towel is the one whose absorbency, coverage and handling fit your vehicle and routine. Use those criteria first, then check the product evidence before deciding.
